fields.name: remittance_number
fields.description: Unique identifier for the remittance advice.

fields.name: payment_date
fields.description: Date on which the payment was issued.

fields.name: payer_name
fields.description: Name of the individual or business making the payment.

fields.name: payer_account_number
fields.description: Bank account or reference number of the payer (if relevant).

fields.name: payee_name
fields.description: Name of the individual or business receiving the payment.

fields.name: payee_account_number
fields.description: Bank account or reference number of the payee (if relevant).

fields.name: total_payment_amount
fields.description: Sum of money being paid in this remittance.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency in which the payment is made.

fields.name: payment_method
fields.description: Method by which the payment was executed.

fields.name: transaction_reference
fields.description: Reference code for the payment transaction (if applicable).

fields.name: fees_deducted
fields.description: Any transaction fees or charges withheld from the payment.

fields.name: remarks
examples: Partial payment for Q3 invoices. Balance to follow next month.
fields.description: Additional notes or comments about the remittance.

document.document_description: A Remittance (Payment) Advice is a document or notification issued by a payer to a payee indicating that an invoice or set of invoices has been paid. It provides details for reconciliation, such as payment date, amount, and references to invoice numbers.
